purpose: Exploratory, no new external data: can the open-loop GPe-STN circuit of the frozen Stage 4A model produce PD-specific 8-15 Hz oscillation once loop gain and STN rebound vary?
spectral: parkinsonian/protocol.json spontaneous block (6,500 ms, first 500 ms discarded, Welch 1,000 ms Hann, 50% overlap, index = mean PSD 8-15 Hz / mean PSD 55-150 Hz)

definitions.pd_specific_oscillation: For one seed: STN and GPi population index in PD >= 1.5 and >= 1.25 x the normal-state index, and normal-state STN index < 1.5 (Stage 4B test 2 plus a normal-state ceiling).
definitions.variant_positive: pd_specific_oscillation in at least 6 of 12 seeds
definitions.calibration_failure: Any group misses its target rate by more than 2 Hz after the last iteration; reported, not dropped.

interpretation_rules: If no variant is positive, the open-loop circuit does not produce PD-specific oscillation within this range. This is consistent with, but does not prove, a need for cortico-thalamic feedback.
If some variants are positive, the claim that a closed loop is required is withdrawn for this model class, and the positive region is reported as a hypothesis about loop gain.
No outcome here is counted as agreement with Tachibana et al. (2011): their pharmacology was already used in Stage 4B.
